text:
Predicates:
GivenOutOnTV(x) ::: x is given out on TV.
OnBachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortrayRealLives(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
Premises:
∃x (GivenOutOnTV(x) ∧ OnMondayAt8pm(x)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (GivenOutOnTV(x) → OnBachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (OnBachelor(x) → PortrayRealLives(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (PortrayRealLives(x) → RealityTVShow(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTVShow(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
OnMondayAt8pm(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is on Monday at 8 pm.
